concept.hr: Koliko puta stane, pomnoži, oduzmi, spusti znamenku; 0 kad je premalo
concept.en: How many times, multiply, subtract, bring down; a 0 when it is too small

summary.hr: Upiši djeljenik i djelitelj i dijeli korak po korak: koliko puta stane, ostatak, spuštam. Vidi zaboravljenu nulu u količniku; bilo koja baza.
summary.en: Type a dividend and a divisor and divide step by step: how many times, the remainder, bring down. See a forgotten 0 in the quotient; any base.

concept.hr: 1 : 3 = 0, i ta 0 drži mjesto; bez nje je 26 umjesto 206
concept.en: 1 : 3 = 0, and that 0 keeps the place; without it 26 instead of 206

title.en: Dividing in base 2: it fits or it does not

concept.en: Every quotient digit is 0 or 1: compare, subtract, bring down
